unknown.why: SOURCE NOW READ (dwc-generic, android14-6.1) but S22 stays UNKNOWN (and is SKIPPED, see its delay row): it needs runtime values. (1) dw_pcie_msi_init() (pcie-designware-host.c:273-284, called at :740) writes DBI 0x820/0x824 (PCIE_MSI_ADDR_LO/HI, rc.h:206-207) with pp->msi_data, a dmam_alloc_coherent() DMA address (pcie-designware-host.c:383-391); it runs because pci_msi_enabled() is true by default, no msi_host_init/msi-parent/msi-map exists (rc.c:2805-2807, dts), so has_msi_ctrl is true (:462); a non-constant, and the Exynos driver rewrites it itself (rc.c:2982-2983). (2) dw_pcie_setup() -> dw_pcie_link_set_max_speed() (pcie-designware.c:489-521, link_gen = DT max-link-speed GEN2 from common.dtsi:373 via :449) addresses LNKCAP/LNKCTL2 at dw_pcie_find_capability(PCI_CAP_ID_EXP)+off, a DBI cap-list walk (:73-82) whose result is read, not constant (expected 0x70 = PCIE_CAP_OFFSET, rc.h:124: a guess until measured). (3) the numeric LINK_SPEED_GEN2 (dt-bindings) and PCI_VENDOR_ID_SAMSUNG (linux pci_ids.h) defines are not in the fetched refs. (4) every Linux DBI access on this path is bracketed by clock enable + PCS rx-elecidle ignore/enable (rd_own_conf rc.c:1269-1312, wr_own_conf rc.c:1314-1356), i.e. extra PCS writes the shim would have to replay.
